chapters.screen: Neural Network (MLP). A small neural network learns a curve by adjusting 97 weights. Watch real training: after every mini-batch of 200 districts, Adam nudges every weight to reduce the squared error, and the curve bends into shape.
chapters.spoken: Neural Network (M-L-P). A small neural network learns a curve by adjusting 97 weights. Watch real training: after every mini-batch of 200 districts, Adam nudges every weight to reduce the squared error, and the curve bends into shape.

chapters.screen: Each dot is one California district: median income (x) and median house value (y). Showing 900 of the 12,384 districts the model trains on.
chapters.spoken: Each dot is one California district: median income and median house value. Showing 900 of the 12,384 districts the model trains on.

chapters.screen: Random starting weights after one mini-batch: the curve sits far below the districts. Validation RMSE $217k.
chapters.spoken: Random starting weights after one mini-batch: the curve sits far below the districts. Validation R-M-S-E 217 thousand dollars.

chapters.screen: Each frame is real training: the first epoch is shown in eighths, then one frame per epoch. Edge colour is the weight's sign; thickness is its size.
chapters.spoken: Each frame is real training: the first epoch is shown in eighths, then one frame per epoch. Edge colour is the weight's sign; thickness is its size.

chapters.screen: 25 epochs: train RMSE $82k, validation $83k. ReLU neurons switch on at different incomes, so the curve is built from straight pieces.
chapters.spoken: 25 epochs: train R-M-S-E 82 thousand dollars, validation 83 thousand dollars. ReLU neurons switch on at different incomes, so the curve is built from straight pieces.

chapters.screen: A forward pass for the unseen district: its income flows through both hidden layers; only neurons with positive input fire, and the output is the price.
chapters.spoken: A forward pass for the unseen district: its income flows through both hidden layers; only neurons with positive input fire, and the output is the price.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model prices all 4,128 test districts it has never seen, a batch at a time. The map shows where it misses: blue = worth more than predicted.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model prices all 4,128 test districts it has never seen, a batch at a time. The map shows where it misses: blue means worth more than predicted.

chapters.screen: The network's ReLU units fold the sheet along straight creases, so it is made of flat facets joined at angles. Same algorithm, now given house age as well as income; height is its predicted price.
chapters.spoken: The network's ReLU units fold the sheet along straight creases, so it is made of flat facets joined at angles. Same algorithm, now given house age as well as income; height is its predicted price.

chapters.screen: Seven more inputs cut the typical error from $83k to $59k.
chapters.spoken: Seven more inputs cut the typical error from 83 thousand dollars to 59 thousand dollars.

chapters.screen: A neural network is many simple units whose weights are tuned together by gradient descent; together they can bend into almost any shape. Limitation: it needs scaled inputs, careful tuning and more data than the other models, and its 97 weights are hard to interpret.
chapters.spoken: A neural network is many simple units whose weights are tuned together by gradient descent; together they can bend into almost any shape. Limitation: it needs scaled inputs, careful tuning and more data than the other models, and its 97 weights are hard to interpret.
